items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: I know Steve and my uncle Tapp.

ctx.x: Can you remember any other piano players in New Orleans? Steve Lewis?
I know Steve Lewis, yeah. I know Steve and my uncle Tapp. His name was, he could play piano. Who? Tapp Kato.

items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You are a cousin of these Kato's. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Adam Jules played piano.

ctx.x: No. Let me get all these relationships straight. You are a cousin of these Kato's. Yeah. And the father of Adam is also named Adam. Yeah. And the uncle of Adam is Tapp. Tapp. Tapp Kato. He played piano. Yeah. And Adam Kato, Senior, played drums. Yeah. Yeah.
